direction_name: HUBB — The Art of the Gathering

color.rules: Warm paper, dark brown readable text; muted olive and terracotta actions

layout.dna: Asymmetric editorial; huge brush-like Arabic title opposite tactile product still life; woven horizontal rules; product carousel; generous varied scenes

texture: painterly flavour strokes on own products
motion_personality: gentle settle 600ms; product hover slight tilt; slow decorative floating limited to 5s; reduced-motion respected
rationale: The emotional word is belonging. The references are a shared majlis table, a paper snack sachet passed between friends, and rhythmic woven edges. Cream paper and umber lettering extend the supplied packaging, while diagonal artwork and asymmetrical composition create a contemporary Saudi shop rather than a ceremonial heritage display.
